verdict.rationale: Railway's own docs say settings can be changed on the canvas with "YAML optional", which implies a first-party YAML configuration path. Nothing shows that one file can define, deploy, and version the whole multi-service architecture. The rollback claim covers deployment versions, not a versioned architecture config file, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation that a single config file defines all services, databases, and networking; config-driven deployment of the whole stack; versioning of that file in source control; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file

citations.quote: Modify settings directly from the canvas. YAML optional.
